name: Cookie Consent
description: GDPR cookie banner injected site-wide on every public page. The admin configures texts, position and theme; visitor choices are logged anonymously (no PII) for compliance stats, and consent can be re-requested from everyone by bumping the config version.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the anonymous consent log to build the compliance stats (totals + last 30 days).
Create the consent log table and insert one anonymous row per visitor choice (accepted/rejected, no PII).
Read the banner configuration (texts, position, theme, version) served to the public banner script.
Save the banner configuration edited in the admin page.
Public endpoints for the banner (config + anonymous choice log) and admin endpoints (config + stats).
Add the Cookie Consent entry to the admin sidebar.
Enqueue the banner script and stylesheet on every public page (this is how the banner appears site-wide).
